analyst_view.overall: Early view: Bournemouth have won all four league-phase games, the latest a 3-1 comeback win at Sparta Prague under Marco Rose, and sit level on 12 points with Benfica and Ferencvaros. Viktoria Plzen picked up their first points with a 1-0 win at Lillestrom after three defeats. A home win would push Bournemouth towards a top-eight place.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals. Bournemouth scored three in Prague with 20 shots and nine on target, which fits the site's view; Plzen's 1-0 at Lillestrom shows they can keep games tight, so I stay with the number rather than push it higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.3 corners. I lean higher: Bournemouth won ten corners in Prague, and Plzen are likely to defend deep at the Vitality Stadium, which tends to push the home side's corner count up.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. Plzen took four yellows at Lillestrom while Bournemouth had two in Prague, so the mix roughly matches the site's split; nothing points clearly either way until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.3 shots. Bournemouth's 20 shots in Prague and Plzen's 15 at Lillestrom suggest the site's figure is about right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.2 shots on target. Bournemouth put nine on target in Prague, in line with the home split here; Plzen managed four at Lillestrom, so there is no clear reason to move.
